maddeler.e:
تتمالكون (form VI)
# تَتَمَالَكُونَ (tatamālakūna) /ta.ta.maː.la.kuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَمَالَكَ (tamālaka)
# تُتَمَالَكُونَ (tutamālakūna) /tu.ta.maː.la.kuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَمَالَكَ (tamālaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
